thread:
kevin_revops: Heads-up: we're preparing a staged price experiment for the "high-throughput" SKU. Plan = opt-in grandfathering for legacy contracts + A/B pricing for new accounts. Putting draft price sheet in Drive: https://drive.company/finance/price-sheets/v2-2026.csv

anya_fin: Outline of proposed behaviors:
- "legacy_opt_in" -> keep existing unit price until end of current invoice period if they opt in
- experiment_v2 -> new customers split 20% control / 80% variant
- reserved_contracts excluded automatically

sam_ops: Ops checklist request: rate-limiter impacts, burst policy, and fallback if metering anomalies > 0.5% of tokens. Also, can we limit variant to accounts with < 5M monthly tokens to avoid capacity thrash?

jess_engineering: Implementation notes: billing-service supports per-customer rate_override. Backfill credit job will run as a dry-run then live. Need cutover timestamp in ISO (we use 2026-04-07T15:00:00Z). Meter export window is hourly; backfill will use UTC day boundaries.

kevin_revops: CSV includes fields: customer_id, billing_entity, contract_type, signup_ts, current_tier. Sample row:
```
customer_id,billing_entity,contract_type,signup_ts,current_tier
acct_204,bill_204,legacy,2022-09-03T12:00:00Z,enterprise
acct_305,bill_305,standard,2025-12-10T08:00:00Z,pro
```

anya_fin: Credit policy proposal: prorated credit for remainder of billing period when "legacy_opt_in" is applied. No retro credits for prior closed invoices. For disputed cases we escalate to RevOps.

tariq_legal: Legal: update TOS snippet required for opt-in messaging + a one-liner about billing adjustments. I'll draft. We need opt-out language and retention of signed opt-in records.

carla_marketing: Messaging notes: two emails. 1) Grandfather confirmation: "No change to your billing for X period". 2) Variant customers: short note on pricing rationale + link to cost control docs. Marketing approval needed by Thu EOD.

billingbot: Automated report: invoice_snapshots coverage = 96.2%. Missing snapshots flagged: acct_112, acct_999. Run archival check: run_archive --ids acct_112,acct_999

jess_engineering: We'll skip accounts without snapshots in automated backfill and produce a CSV of candidates for manual handling. Backfill job plan: dry-run (staging) -> manual review -> live run. Dry-run scheduled 2026-04-05T02:00:00Z.

sam_ops: For routing: heavy IO customers on the variant will get a soft-cap of 80% qps and auto-route to dedicated if sustained above threshold for 10 minutes. I'll post policy in #eng-infra.

kevin_revops: Exceptions: sales can request legacy_opt_in for strategic customers. Process = Zendesk ticket -> revops approves -> billing-change recorded. SLA target 48h.

anya_fin: Approval matrix: finance approves credit policy; legal approves TOS text; product + eng sign off on rollout steps. Requesting signoffs by Friday COB so we can publish next Wednesday.

carla_marketing: Will prep email drafts + support FAQ. Also suggest a one-page merchant-facing summary for reps.

jess_engineering: Note: credits computed per billing_entity (not per-org). Also we'll add a boolean metadata flag "legacy_opt_in": true/false in customer profile service. Change is minor, rollout in next patch.

kevin_revops: Thanks. If everyone is aligned I'll lock the price sheet at 2026-04-02T12:00:00Z and trigger the staging run. Tagging @tariq_legal @anya_fin.

billingbot: Reminder: staging billing simulation at 2026-04-05T02:00:00Z will include a sample of 1500 accounts. Use --cohort-file https://drive.company/finance/cohorts/sim-1500.csv

tariq_legal: I'll post drafted TOS changes here within 24h.

anya_fin: Final note: track delta in MRR and gross margin vs control for 30 days post-publish. We'll want automated dashboards.

kevin_revops: Great. Follow-ups in thread. Please add any blocking items.
